evals.name: full-kickoff-document-review
evals.prompt: Ik wil een klantportal op mortelos/starter: klanten zien hun dossiers en uploaden documenten; account managers reviewen en keuren ze goed via de inbox. Richt het fundament in en lever een compleet bouwplan.
evals.expected_output: Runs pre-flight on the host context first; starts a deep, one-question-at-a-time interview that establishes portal name + goal + slug BEFORE detail; works capability-first; closes the coverage-map dimensions (roles, read/write, sources, approval, surface, audit, reuse, domain model, policy matrix, inbox workflow, tenancy, observability, packaging, non-functional, first slice); records a package decision; produces docs/portals/<slug>/capability-map.md, build-plan.md and progress.md with no TBDs; documents tenant identity as host-owned; seeds deny-by-default policy abilities; picks a first vertical slice and stops at a checkpoint instead of building everything autonomously.

evals.name: capability-only-with-connector
evals.prompt: Klanten moeten documenten kunnen uploaden en finance haalt omzetdata uit Moneybird op.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this as a portal kickoff even though the word 'portal' is absent; begins the capability-first interview one question at a time; branches into the connector dimension for Moneybird (auth model, sync direction/frequency, failure/reauth, data classification) and into the approval/inbox dimension if document upload needs review; does not jump straight to writing code before the capability map is confirmed.

evals.name: resume-existing-portal
evals.prompt: Ik wil verder met het klantdossier-portal.
evals.expected_output: Pre-flight detects an existing portal under docs/portals/<slug>/ and reads progress.md; offers to RESUME at the first open item rather than restarting the interview or clobbering existing work; summarizes what is already done (foundation, completed capabilities) and proposes the next slice.
